title: Sprint Contract
description: Pre-sprint agreement between orchestrator, generator, and evaluator. Defines scope, rubric, thresholds, and budget for one sprint.

sprintId.description: Unique identifier for this sprint (e.g., 'sprint-001', ISO8601 timestamp).

scope.description: List of feature IDs to be completed in this sprint.

rubric.description: Evaluation rubric: list of per-criterion pass/fail checks.

description.description: Human-readable description of how to evaluate this criterion.

thresholds.description: Hard pass/fail thresholds for this sprint.

minimumCriteriaMet.description: Minimum number of criteria that must pass (must be ≥ 1).

minimumWeightedScore.description: Minimum weighted score (0–1) required to pass the sprint.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens the generator can use.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries if generator fails evaluator thresholds.

timeoutMinutes.description: Maximum wall-clock time for generator + evaluator (minutes).

generatorInstructions.description: Specific instructions for the generator (e.g., 'Implement features F-001 and F-002, leaving repo buildable').

evaluatorInstructions.description: Specific instructions for the evaluator (e.g., 'Run test suite and verify all criteria pass').

notes.description: Orchestrator notes on this sprint's goals or known risks.
